body:
Fixes #3208

Phones can now tell a folder link from a missing file, and list a folder.

## Route

`GET /api/v1/mobile/agents/{agentId}/link?href={href}`. Pinned mTLS, same as `/content`. It answers 200 with one of:

- `{version:1, type:"file", path, name, kind, size}`. `kind` is the preview kind (`text`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `pdf`, `other`).
- `{version:1, type:"directory", path, name, entries:[{name, kind:"file"|"directory"|"symlink"|"other", size?}], truncated}`. Entries are sorted by name and capped at 500. Symlinks are listed without being followed.
- `{version:1, type:"missing"}`
- `{version:1, type:"not_allowed"}`. This covers network and device paths, a `file:` URL for another host, an href over 1024 characters, a path that can't be read (EACCES/EPERM/ELOOP), a folder whose listing can't be read, and anything that is neither a file nor a folder (FIFO, socket).

Errors: 400 `invalid_query`, 404 `agent_not_found`, 404 `content_unavailable` while rich content is off, 403 `client_certificate_required` or `authorization_revoked`.

New capability: `chatLinks: {version:1, path, maxEntries:500}`.

## Resolution is shared with desktop

- `inspectChatLink` in `chat-files.ts` now holds the logic that `resolveChatLink` used to hold. It covers relative links against the worktree, absolute paths as given, percent-decoding, dropping `#heading`, the length cap, refusing UNC and device paths, and realpath. It returns a typed result instead of throwing.
- `resolveChatLink` maps that result to its old answers. Desktop behavior and desktop tests are unchanged.
- To tell `not_allowed` from `missing`, `inspectChatLink` checks why `resolveLocalPath` came back empty. That check only runs when the lookup fails.

## Sandbox rules kept from `/content`

Both routes now go through the same `mobileRichContentRoute` wrapper in `annex-server.ts`, so they apply the same rules:

- a pinned client certificate from a paired phone controller
- the capabilities epoch, with the pin and controller role rechecked after the IO
- the agent must be known and not disposed (or a tracked quick agent)
- the `richChatContent` setting, rechecked after the read
- strict query validation: only `href`, exactly once, not empty
- `Cache-Control: no-store`
- no logging or telemetry of paths

As with `/content`, there is no project-root confinement (#2478).

The route logic is in a new module, `annex-chat-links.ts`. `mobile-control.ts` and `mobile-agents.ts` are untouched.

## Docs and fixtures

- New "Chat links" section in `docs/mobile-control-v1.md`.
- `test/fixtures/annex-mobile/chat-links.json` covers file, image, folder with and without a trailing slash, an encoded folder, missing, not_allowed, invalid_query and agent_not_found.
- `capabilities.json` gains `chatLinks`.
- The telemetry route enum gains `GET /api/v1/mobile/agents/:id/link`.

## Validation

- `annex-chat-links.test.ts` covers: file, folder with and without a trailing slash, missing, not_allowed (UNC path, remote `file:` URL, over-length href, FIFO, chmod 000 folder), percent-encoded href with `#heading`, Windows-style paths built with `path.join`/`path.sep`, absolute paths outside the project, the listing cap with `truncated`, a symlink that isn't followed, bad queries, and the setting rechecked after the read.
- `npm run typecheck`: clean.
- `npm run lint`: 0 errors.
- Full `npm test` under load 20+: 26599 passed, 2 timed out in `copilot/fixture-replay.test.ts`. Run alone, that file passes 31/31.

title: Mobile: resolve chat links (file, folder, missing) and list folders (#3208)
